The safest and most direct approach is to delete just the snapshot_base_full.qcow2 file which alone provides 46 GB (well above the 32 GB minimum required).

I'll proceed with deleting the snapshot_base_full.qcow2 file since it alone exceeds the 32 GB requirement and has no protection status.
